generation.scope: The split and nonsplit double twisted cubics are impossible. For the nonsplit ribbon the Picard recurrence forces an ordinary unipotent shift and exact cyclic chart elimination contradicts embedding. No union of a twisted cubic and an integral quartic can be septic. All septic point graphs now have finite AS/isomorphism atlases; the only residual sextic support without established marks is two twisted cubics meeting in length four.

open_mathematics: Study a length-four intersection of two twisted cubics: separate the hyperelliptic matching from the canonical conic pair, use opposite rank divisors and trisecants, and analyze the surviving component permutations. Also address rational cubic hulls with embedded defects, general finite windows and positive fibers.
